main_text.p: זאת Hæc, Hoc, Ista, Istud, cum א in medio, loco ה: זֹאת הָאָרֶץ Hæc terra, Deuter.34.4. וְכָזֹאת כְּזֹאת Sicut hoc & sicut hoc, id est, Hæc & talia mecum locuta est, 2.Reg.5.8.

זָהָב masc. Aurum: metonymicè, Aureus nummus: ut, וְשֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים זָהָב Et sex millia auri, id est, aureorum, 2.Reg.5.5. Metaphoricè, Serenitas, Serenum, Aurescens lux, ut Varro dixit, Aurescit aër, de L.L. lib.6. מִצָּפוֹן זָהָב יֵאָתֶה Ab Aquilone venit aurea lux, Job.37.22. id est, Serenitas purissima: nam venti aquilonares dispellunt nubes: Aben Esra, זוֹהַר הַשָּׁמַיִם Splendor cœli, qui similis est colori auri. Item, Limpidus, Aureus liquor, Zach.4.12. Constr. וְזָהָב הָאָרֶץ Et aurum terræ, Gen.2.12. Aff. זְהָבוֹ Auri sui, Jes.2.20. Talmudici septem genera auri numerant in Joma, fol.44.2. Primum, זָהָב generale est. 2 זָהָב טוֹב Aurum bonum, Gen.2.12. quod distinctum ab auro vulgari. 3 זָהָב אוֹפִיר Aurum Ophir, de quo in אֹפִיר: 4 זָהָב מוּפָז I.Reg.10.18. vide פָּז. 5 זָהָב שְׁחוּט 2.Par.9.15. vide שְׁחֹט: 6 זָהָב סָגוֹר I.Reg.6.20. vide סָגֹר. 7 זָהָב פַּרְוִים Aurum Parvajim, 2.Par.3.6. sic dictum, quòd simile sit לְדַם הַפָּרִים sanguini juvencorum. Hæc illi. Sed sunt plura, veluti בָּצָר, חָרוּץ, כֶּתֶם, quæ vide suis locis.

זָהַם Pih. Fastidivit, Derestatus est[?], tanquam sordidum & immundum: Præter. fœmin. cum Affix. וְזֶהֱמָתוֹ חַיָּתוֹ לָחֶם Et fastidivit vita ejus panem, Job.33.20. In Targum est Polluere, Inquinare: polluta abominabilia sunt.

זָהַר Hiphil. הִזְהִיר Splenduit, Fulsit: metaphoricè, Monuit, Admonuit, Præmonuit, Commonefecit: Præter. וַיַּזְהִיר אֶת־הָעָם Et monuit populum, Ezech.33.3. Futur. יַזְהִירוּ כּוֹהַר Splendebunt sicut splendor, Dan.12.3. Niph. Præter. נִזְהַר Admonitus, Ezech.3.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and some Hebrew forms are read from a low-resolution scan and may contain errors. "Derestatus est" is doubtful. Entry headwords are set larger and are treated as the first words of their paragraphs. Right-hand Hebrew "זה" at the top is taken as the running head. Page number 181 at top left is partly blurred.
